request.state:
Subject: firefox + features

Hello

I'm trying to find a best site for my tracks + photos. There's a dozen 
of the websites and evaluating each one of them takes a lot of time.

Your one seem to be of the best but there's a critical issue - it seem 
to lack support of Firefox browser. I'm surprised to see a modern site 
not supporting this browser but anyway. To be more specific, signup & 
adding tracks works in IE only.

I know, there's a work around - i can use upload application, but it 
does not work either - when it tries to upload the files it just sits 
there waiting with zero progress then reports error...

These are the features i'm looking for when evaluating gps tracking sites:

- ability to specify what sort of google map i want to see for EACH 
track (usually i prefer terrain as this is the most informative about 
the track), my second choice is standard map, and never it is a 
satellite view.

- how detailed is the tack (i found that some web sites do too much
rounding to make size of several mb track smaller)

- ability to upload photos, site should support EXIF geo data too.

- easy viewing of photos (sort of album view), not only clicking on 
pictures on the map.

- detailed stats: max speed, average speed, max height, min height, 
elevation and speed graph, duration, length.

Regards,
Alexei
